authority.from_memory: nothing — every rule cites its source

grammar_summary.entry: u32 'NVAR' | u16 total size | u24 next (0xFFFFFF = chain end, RELATIVE to entry start) | u8 attributes (8 flags: valid.80 auth_write.40 hw_error.20 ext_header.10 data_only.08 local_guid.04 ascii_name.02 runtime.01) | [guid inline 16B | guid_index u8] | name (ascii strz | ucs2) | data | [ext header at entry end: attrs u8, optional timestamp u8/hash 32B/checksum u8, u16 ext size last]
grammar_summary.store: entries back to back until a non-'N' terminator byte; free space; GUID area = LAST N*16 bytes of the store, indexed backwards (index 0 = final 16 bytes)
grammar_summary.defaults: AMI ships factory defaults as ONE outer StdDefaults variable (GUID 4599D26F-1A11-49B8-...) whose DATA is itself a nested NVAR store (nvramparser.cpp 288-291 recursion)

validation.walk_errors: 0 across 7 stores (6 FFS-anchored + MSI mirror) and 7 nested stores

validation.terminators: clean on all 14 walks; free space uniformly 0xFF

the ext-header checksum path is implemented and ready but exercised by 0 entries in factory stores (registered: the factory NVRAM ships no ext headers on these six images)
the live NVRAM (first boot, updates, user settings) is a day-0 measurement: chains, data_only continuations and ext headers are expected to appear there, not in virgin images
day0_consequences: the dump's NVRAM parses with this lens verbatim: FFS anchor CEF5B9A3, linear walk, nested StdDefaults, GUID area tail
